en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal city with mountains in the background. In the foreground, a small rowboat is on calm water, while several larger ships are moored along the waterfront lined with low-rise buildings. Printed captions in French and Greek identify the location, and there is a circular postal or institutional stamp on the left and a website watermark at the bottom.
